title_zh: 核对晋升反馈并约定准备项目计划

scenario.label_zh: 根据晋升反馈约定准备项目计划
scenario.goal_zh: 明确本轮未获晋升的反馈，约定先起草带领小项目的计划再与经理讨论

context_zh: 员工向经理澄清一次晋升评估后的反馈。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: I didn't get the promotion, but the feedback doesn't tell me what to work on next.

sentences.speaker: Manager
sentences.text: Your technical work is strong. The panel wanted more evidence that you can guide a project involving other people.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Could I lead the small website update rather than wait for a much larger project?

sentences.speaker: Manager
sentences.text: That could give you relevant experience. Draft a plan showing the work and who you'd need, and we'll discuss it.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: I'll bring a plan to our next meeting. I understand that doing the project wouldn't guarantee a new role.
